build.name: Build production artifacts
build.run:
$downloadArgs = @("--version", $env:SDKWORK_PACKAGE_VERSION, "--release-tag", $env:SDKWORK_RELEASE_TAG)
if ($env:CLOUDROUTER_DOWNLOAD_CDN_BASE_URL) {
  $downloadArgs += @("--cdn-base-url", $env:CLOUDROUTER_DOWNLOAD_CDN_BASE_URL)
}
node scripts/update-cloud-router-downloads.mjs @downloadArgs
node scripts/build-cloud-router-production.mjs
cargo build -p sdkwork-cloudrouter-installer --bin cloudrouterctl --release

stage.name: Stage production files
stage.run:
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$stage = Join-Path (Get-Location) "dist/install-package-staging"
$output = Join-Path (Get-Location) "dist/install-packages"
Remove-Item -LiteralPath $stage -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Remove-Item -LiteralPath $output -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Join-Path $stage "bin") | Out-Null
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Join-Path $stage "portal") | Out-Null
$suffix = if ($IsWindows) { ".exe" } else { "" }
$gateway = "sdkwork-api-cloudrouter-standalone-gateway$suffix"
Copy-Item -LiteralPath "target/release/$gateway" -Destination (Join-Path $stage "bin/cloudrouter$suffix")
Copy-Item -LiteralPath "target/release/cloudrouterctl$suffix" -Destination (Join-Path $stage "bin/cloudrouterctl$suffix")
Copy-Item -LiteralPath ".env.release.example" -Destination (Join-Path $stage ".env.release.example")
Copy-Item -LiteralPath "apps/sdkwork-cloudrouter-pc/dist/standalone/prod" -Destination (Join-Path $stage "portal/dist") -Recurse
Copy-Item -LiteralPath "apps/sdkwork-cloudrouter-pc/dist/sdk-archives" -Destination (Join-Path $stage "portal/dist/sdk-archives") -Recurse

package.name: Build selected install package

validate.name: Validate selected install package

sign.name: Sign artifacts (cosign for OCI + signtool for MSI + codesign for pkg)

sbom.name: Create supply-chain attestation and artifact evidence
